The cover displays the PS5 logo, the title God of War Ragnarok, PEGI 18 rating, and artwork of Kratos and Atreus.
A PREZIN Gadgets store sign is visible in the background, and a PREZIN GADGETS watermark overlays the image.
No console, box, manual, or game disc is visible in the photo.

God of War Ragnarok title on the cover in photo 0

risks.proof: Photo of the opened case showing the disc inside, or a close-up of the disc itself

risks.risk: The disc may be scratched, cracked, or unreadable
risks.proof: Video of the disc being inserted into a PS5 and the game launching successfully

risks.risk: The game may be the wrong region for the buyer's console

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the case showing region and barcode
Photo of the game disc itself
Video of the game installing and running on a PlayStation 5 console
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PlayStation 5 God of War Ragnarok game case from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case (missing or non-working disc) while awaiting proof of condition.
